title: Tombstones manifest — automecanik-raw/manifests/tombstones.json
description: Schema for documented deletion tombstones. Required by ADR-031 §D21 (no silent suppressions). Each entry traces the original path, reason, decision metadata, and checksum baseline.

version.description: Schema version. Bump major on breaking changes.

original_path.description: Full path of the deleted item. May be filesystem path, DB object (DB:schema.table), or external URL.

reason.description: Free-form explanation. Must be specific enough that a future reader understands why this was deleted.

decided_at.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD of the decision (not necessarily the deletion date)

decided_by.description: Decision-maker handle (@fafa, @cowork, etc.). Must be a real human or signed agent identity.

checksum_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the deleted content (file content or DB dump). Allows future verification if rollback is needed.

audit_run_id.description: Identifier of the audit run that decided this tombstone (e.g. 'phase-f-prep-20260501', 'incident-2026-005-cleanup')

rollback_path.description: Optional. Path to rollback artifact if recovery is possible (e.g. 'automecanik-rag/knowledge/.rollback-20260501/<file>').

supersedes.description: Optional. ID of a previous tombstone that this one replaces or refines.
